scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn --app-dir apps/api/src amazon_ai_api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test:infra: uv run --project apps/api python -m unittest discover -s infra/tests -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:api && npm run test:infra
scripts.seed:synthetic: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/seed_synthetic.py --output-dir synthetic-output --load-postgres
